description:
Design a vertical employee ID badge for 'Nexus Dynamics'. 

1. Set the Page Size to custom dimensions: Width 2.13 inches, Height 3.38 inches (Standard CR80 size).
2. Create the design with:
   - Header: 'NEXUS DYNAMICS' (Bold)
   - Photo placeholder: A rectangle or circle in the upper center labeled 'Photo'
   - Employee Details: Name 'Alex Mercer', Title 'Systems Architect', ID 'ND-8942'
   - Footer: A blue bar at the bottom
3. Insert a QR Code containing the text 'ND-8942' and place it on the badge.
4. Save the native file as '/home/ga/Documents/nexus_id_badge.eddx'.
5. Export the design as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/nexus_id_badge.png'.
